title: Meta-Reflective Evolution Effectively Improves Production AI Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.12794v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-guided evolutionary optimization has successfully improved prompts, programs, and even entire AI systems. Most optimization methods select a candidate from the search frontier, then mutate it in one LLM pass based only on its failures. This focus on the frontier can stall on production AI systems, where isolated failures reveal little about complex, hidden interactions. We introduce CoCoEvolve (Cortex Code Evolve), an evolutionary optimizer built around what we call meta-reflection, wherein an agentic mutator (Cortex Code) selectively retrieves evidence from the entire evolutionary history and probes the live system before verifying and proposing mutations. We apply CoCoEvolve to optimize three classes of production AI systems: data agents, LLM-powered data pipelines, and data engineering workflows. translated_title: 元反思式进化有效改进生产级AI系统
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.12794v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：由大语言模型（LLM）引导的进化优化已成功改进了提示词、程序，乃至整个AI系统。大多数优化方法从搜索前沿中选取一个候选，然后仅基于其失败情况，在单次LLM调用中对其进行变异。这种对搜索前沿的关注在生产级AI系统上可能陷入停滞，因为孤立的失败很难揭示复杂的隐藏交互。我们提出了CoCoEvolve（Cortex Code Evolve），一个围绕我们称之为“元反思”（meta-reflection）机制构建的进化优化器，其中智能体变异器（Cortex Code）会选择性地从整个进化历史中检索证据，并在验证和提出变异之前探测实际运行的系统。我们将CoCoEvolve应用于优化三类生产级AI系统：数据智能体、基于LLM的数据流水线以及数据工程工作流。在DABStep上，CoCoEvolve登顶公开排行榜，在留出难题集上达到92.8%的准确率，相比之下基线仅为78.4%（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出基于“元反思”机制的进化优化器CoCoEvolve，通过从完整进化历史中检索证据并探测运行中的系统来指导变异，在DABStep上以92.8%的难题准确率登顶排行榜，有效改进了数据智能体、LLM数据流水线和数据工程工作流等生产级AI系统。
en_tdlr: CoCoEvolve, an evolutionary optimizer built around meta-reflection that selectively retrieves evidence from the entire evolutionary history and probes the live system before proposing mutations, tops the DABStep leaderboard with 92.8% held-out hard accuracy (vs. 78.4% baseline), effectively improving production AI systems including data agents, LLM-powered data pipelines, and data engineering workflows.
